what_reading_production_changed.migration_167_is_dropped: The plan proposed backfilling go_live_date from window_end. Production has window_end on 2 of 11 sets, window_start on 8, content_end_date on 0, and production_mode on 1 of 6 contracts. migration_runner_fault_found: run-164.js and its siblings read .env.prod-backup for --dry and .env for the REAL run. In this working copy .env points at LOCALHOST — so the dry run inspects production and a real run would have applied to a local database and printed COMMITTED. Which database is being written to must never be a side effect of a different flag. run-165-166.js now takes an EXPLICIT --dry or --apply, reads prod credentials for both, PRINTS THE HOST before touching anything, refuses when neither or both flags are given (exit 2), and refuses --apply against localhost. 163 and 164 were verified present in production, so they did reach it by some other path.

correction_2026_09_01: RECORD CORRECTED. Every contract since brief-straight-to-signing has said cancelInfluencer writes an invalid CONTRACT_STATUS.
